WITH ref AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.122317 42.376159)', 4326)::geometry AS g
),
nearest AS (
  SELECT r.road_name,
         r.geometry::geometry AS geom,
         ST_Distance(r.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.122317 42.376159)', 4326)::geography) AS dist_m
  FROM roads r, ref
  WHERE r.highway = 'residential'
    AND r.road_name IS NOT NULL
    AND ST_Dimension(r.geometry::geometry) = 1
    AND ST_NPoints(r.geometry::geometry) BETWEEN 2 AND 50
    AND r.geometry::geometry && ST_MakeEnvelope(-126, 24, -66, 50, 4326)
    AND ST_DWithin(r.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.122317 42.376159)', 4326)::geography, 100000)
  ORDER BY r.geometry::geometry <-> ref.g
  LIMIT 1
),
segments AS (
  SELECT (ST_DumpSegments(n.geom)).geom AS seg FROM nearest n
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT ST_StartPoint(seg) AS p1,
         ST_EndPoint(seg)   AS p2,
         ST_Length(seg::geography) AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT e.seg_len_m,
         z1.v AS z1,
         z2.v AS z2
  FROM endpoints e
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, e.p1) AS v
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, e.p1)
    LIMIT 1
  ) z1 ON z1.v IS NOT NULL
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, e.p2) AS v
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, e.p2)
    LIMIT 1
  ) z2 ON z2.v IS NOT NULL
),
slopes AS (
  SELECT seg_len_m,
         CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m ELSE NULL END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT n.road_name,
       n.dist_m,
       DEGREES(ATAN(SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0))) AS slope_deg
FROM nearest n
CROSS JOIN slopes
WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY n.road_name, n.dist_m;

```sql
WITH radcliffe_point AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-71.122317, 42.376159), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
residential_roads AS (
  SELECT 
    id, 
    geometry AS geom
  FROM 
    roads
  WHERE 
    highway = 'residential'
),
closest_road AS (
  SELECT 
    r.id,
    r.geom,
    ST_Distance(r.geom::geometry, radcliffe_point.geom::geometry) AS distance_meters
  FROM 
    residential_roads r,
    radcliffe_point
  ORDER BY 
    distance_meters
  LIMIT 1
),
road_raster_intersection AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Intersection(
      public.dem_us.rast, 
      closest_road.geom::geometry
    ) AS clipped_rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us,
    closest_road
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(public.dem_us.rast, closest_road.geom::geometry)
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Slope(clipped_rast, 1, '32BF') AS slope_rast
  FROM 
    road_raster_intersection
),
average_slope AS (
  SELECT 
    (ST_SummaryStats(slope_rast, TRUE)).mean AS avg_slope_degrees
  FROM 
    slope_raster
)
SELECT 
  'Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Studies'::text AS feature_name,
  closest_road.distance_meters AS distance_to_road_meters,
  average_slope.avg_slope_degrees AS average_slope_degrees
FROM 
  closest_road,
  average_slope;
```
